{{Youmay|the position of Chief Contractor Liaison|the position of [[Chief Liaison]]}}
'''Chief Contractor Liaison''' was a position held by [[Devron Zal]] at [[Radell Mining Corporation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Chief Contract Liaison was responsible for the hiring or temporary and contract employees.
